sources.snippet: The model carries biases commonly encountered online and is trained on English and French data only. The training details of Falcon-7B include information about the training data, training procedure, and hyperparameters used. It was trained on 384 A100 40GB GPUs using a 2D parallelism strategy combined with ZeRO.

sources.title: Falcon H1R 7B - Falcon LLM
sources.snippet: Falcon H1R 7B proves that advanced reasoning no longer requires large model sizes, thereby setting a new benchmark for intelligent and cost-effective deployable AI. This is a leap forward in the reasoning capabilities of compact AI systems showing how scientific precision and scalable design can go hand in hand.
